title: TAC JettonProxy unauthenticated transfer_notification relay is inert; release is CCL/operator-gated and the EVM mint is a 1-of-1 sequencer root
closed_reasons: TON release requires msg.sender == CCL (SDEQ/THROWIFNOT 70 in both 0xae7df95b and 0x7817b330 handlers)
CCL TON release batch is signed by an operator pubkey (CHKSIGNU against GETGLOB 4) and checked against a signed-message dictionary (THROWIFNOT 201)
EVM receiveMessage mints only after Consensus.checkMerkleRoot(root); forged call reverts InvalidMerkleProof (0xb05e92fa)
Consensus is 1-of-1 (single EOA voter 0x8f1B53B1Bf9b24BAa2054Bd2d8C0b7923ABff9df), not an externally satisfiable quorum
The only unverified control is the off-chain sequencer jetton-wallet filter, which the TAC post-mortem says was fixed
key_facts: JettonProxy holds 553,035.155657 USDT (wallet 0:ab2d4b7c1c11305197fff4ccbfdd855f737c1cd5d58f1f4cf28b0f37d957e372), 74,263,651.686793 BLUM, 2,780.212482 tsTON; liquid USD 624,189.97
0x7362d09c relay branch has no SDEQ; it only queues a deposit to the CCL
Both proxy release branches (0xae7df95b, 0x7817b330) require sender == CCL; last 200 txs show 82 inbound 0x7817b330 all from CCL
CCL TON code hash B83804BBE2408DF8136DA74DD40BFCC5F5A85814D753A9814563108E4134E988; external op 0x4b19e42a is CHKSIGNU-gated by pubkey b76b6f56...
CCL EVM proxy 0x9fee01e948353E0897968A3ea955815aaA49f58d -> impl 0x01BC6bbf156436F09E07ab0392332f6d2636026d; receiveMessage reverts InvalidMerkleProof for a forged message
Single voter is an EOA (code 0x, nonce 44,571), not an on-chain quorum
caveats: The deployed sequencer binary is not public; the post-fix jetton-wallet check (code hash + minter) was not inspected. A code-hash+minter-only check would leave a theoretical non-canonical-address bypass.
The single voter EOA is a key-compromise risk (P), not an external unprivileged path.
No TVM emulation was run; conclusions rest on live code disassembly, real traces, and the verified EVM source/state.
TON balances/activity move; the quoted amounts are a snapshot at lt 114240958000060.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: the TON relay is real but the release is CCL/operator-signed and the EVM mint needs a Merkle root from a 1-of-1 sequencer EOA; ~$624k is P/conditional, not E-U.
